info.title: CrustAPI
info.description: Self-scraped Google and public LinkedIn data as a clean JSON API. One endpoint returns a stable, serper-compatible shape for every Google surface: Web Search, Maps, Places, News, Shopping, Images, Videos, Reviews, Scholar, Patents, Autocomplete, and Webpage scrape. Choose a surface with `type`. A second endpoint returns public LinkedIn profiles, companies, posts, jobs, and people search. Billed on success with never-expiring, top-up credits: 1 credit per successful query for every type (Maps bills 1 credit per business returned); empty results are free.

get.description: One endpoint for the whole Google menu. Set `type` to choose the surface (default `web`). Each type returns a serper-compatible shape under its own key: web/scholar/patents/lens -> `organic`; news -> `news`; shopping -> `shopping`; images -> `images`; videos -> `videos`; maps/places -> `places`; reviews -> `reviews`; autocomplete -> `suggestions`; webpage -> `text` + `metadata` + `jsonld`. Billed 1 credit per successful query (Maps bills 1 credit per business returned). Blocked/empty rides are free.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Which Google surface to query.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The search query. Required for every type EXCEPT webpage and lens (use `url`) and reviews (use `placeId` / `cid` / `fid`).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: type=webpage: the page URL to scrape. type=lens: the image URL for reverse image search.

parameters.name: gl
parameters.description: Country code (us, gb, de, ...). Not used by maps, patents, or webpage.

parameters.name: hl
parameters.description: Language code (en, es, ...). Not used by patents or webpage.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Result page. Not used by reviews, autocomplete, webpage, or lens.

parameters.name: tbs
parameters.description: Time filter for web/news/images/videos (e.g. qdr:h past hour, qdr:d past day, qdr:w past week, qdr:m past month, qdr:y past year).

parameters.name: num
parameters.description: type=reviews: reviews per page (default 20, max 50).

parameters.name: ll
parameters.description: type=maps: GPS position and zoom as @latitude,longitude,zoom.

parameters.name: placeId
parameters.description: Google place id (ChIJ...). Optional for maps; identifies the place for reviews.

parameters.name: cid
parameters.description: Google customer id. Optional for maps; identifies the place for reviews.

parameters.name: fid
parameters.description: Google feature id (0x..:0x..). Identifies the place for reviews.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: type=reviews: review sort order.

parameters.name: nextPageToken
parameters.description: type=reviews: cursor from the previous response to fetch the next page of reviews.

parameters.name: includeMarkdown
parameters.description: type=webpage: also return the page rendered as Markdown.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: City/region hint for web and places.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: type=maps only: how many businesses to return (1-100). Each is one credit.

parameters.name: stars
parameters.description: type=maps: include the 1-5 star rating distribution per place.

200.description: Results for the chosen surface. The populated array key depends on `type`.

get.description: Public (logged-out) LinkedIn data. Set `type` to choose what you get (default `profile`). profile/company/posts need `url`; jobs takes `keywords` (plus optional `location`) or a job `url`; search (people search) needs `keywords`. The data comes back under a key named after the type: `profile` and `company` are objects, `posts`, `jobs`, and `people` (for type=search) are arrays. Billed 1 credit per successful call. Exception: people search with `enrich=true` bills 1 credit per full profile returned. Empty results are free. A private or empty profile returns 200 with null plus a note and is not charged.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: What to fetch. Singular gets the one you point at, plural finds many: person (one profile by URL) / people (find people by keywords) / company / job (one job by URL) / jobs (find jobs by keywords) / posts / refresh (fast freshness check). `profile` and `search` are the previous names for person and people and keep working unchanged.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A linkedin.com URL. Required for profile (linkedin.com/in/...), company (linkedin.com/company/...), and posts (either). jobs also accepts a job URL instead of keywords.

parameters.name: keywords
parameters.description: What to search for. Required for type=search; required for type=jobs unless you pass a job `url`.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: type=jobs: city/region filter for the job search.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: type=jobs: result offset for paging.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many results to return. jobs: default 25, max 50. posts: default 50, max 100. search: default 10, max 15.

parameters.name: enrich
parameters.description: type=search: return each person's FULL profile in the same call. Bills 1 credit per full profile returned instead of 1 per call.

parameters.name: employees
parameters.description: type=company: include the employee list.

parameters.name: comments
parameters.description: type=posts: include comments on each post.

parameters.name: member
parameters.description: type=refresh: also return memberIdentifier, LinkedIn's permanent numeric member id. It requires reading the full profile page, so it is opt-in; the id is static, so fetch it once and keep it.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: type=profile only. When true, appends workEmail, emailStatus (verified | pattern-likely | unknown) and emailConfidence to the person record. Included in the same 1 credit, best-effort; a guess is never labeled verified.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: type=profile with email=true only. The employer's domain (e.g. stripe.com). When supplied, the email finder uses it directly instead of resolving the company from the profile's experience — faster, and it also works for profiles LinkedIn serves in restricted view (name only, no employer), where the domain otherwise cannot be resolved. Accepts a bare domain, a subdomain, or a full URL. Alias: companyDomain.

parameters.name: headline
parameters.description: type=profile: for profiles whose companyState is `restricted`, attempt to recover the member's own public headline (free text, often naming the employer). Best effort, roughly one in twenty.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: type=people only. Find people by profession (e.g. "accountants", "real estate agents"). Combine with location for a single city ("Chicago, IL"). Values come from LinkedIn public service categories; an unknown profession returns no results rather than a guess. Alias: profession.

200.description: Public LinkedIn data for the chosen type. The populated data key depends on `type` (`people` for search). A private or empty profile returns null plus a note, uncharged.

400.description: Missing or invalid url or keywords.

get.description: A public, rate-limited demo of the search endpoint. No API key. For trying the API without signing up.

post.summary: Refresh many LinkedIn profiles in one request
post.description: Send up to 100 profile URLs and get results back IN INPUT ORDER. Built for keeping a large database current without one HTTP round trip per profile. Billing matches the single endpoint: one credit per successful row, not-accessible rows are free, and a malformed URL is returned as a per-row error rather than charged. A failing row never fails the batch.

urls.description: linkedin.com/in/ URLs or bare vanity ids.

schema.description: profile only: return the ScrapIn-compatible shape.

data.description: Present when ok. The same shape the single endpoint returns.

400.description: Bad body, no urls, or more than 100 urls.

SearchResult.description: Polymorphic result. `searchParameters` echoes your request; the populated array key depends on `type`.

nextPageToken.description: type=reviews: cursor for the next page.

source.description: Scholar publication info / Lens source site.

thumbnailUrl.description: Lens: thumbnail of the matched image.

publicationInfo.description: Scholar: authors, journal and year as one line.

year.description: Scholar: publication year parsed from publicationInfo.

pdfUrl.description: Scholar: link to the PDF copy when one is offered.

id.description: Scholar: Google Scholar cluster id for the result.

htmlUrl.description: Scholar: full-text link when the side resource is an HTML copy (pdfUrl is null then).

Place.description: A place. type=places returns the lean serper-parity subset; type=maps returns this full shape (contact details, categories, opening hours, attributes and photos on top).

priceLevel.description: Google's price band token, e.g. "$1–10". Null when Google shows none.

thumbnailUrl.description: A real place photo URL (maps only).

bookingLinks.description: Reservation/booking URLs when the place is bookable (maps only, sparse).

url.description: Google Maps place URL. type=maps only (the richer Maps shape; type=places returns the lean serper-parity set).

fid.description: Google feature id (0x…:0x…), usable as an input to type=reviews. type=maps only (the richer Maps shape; type=places returns the lean serper-parity set).

street.description: Street line of the address. type=maps only (the richer Maps shape; type=places returns the lean serper-parity set).

city.description: type=maps only (the richer Maps shape; type=places returns the lean serper-parity set).

state.description: type=maps only (the richer Maps shape; type=places returns the lean serper-parity set).

postalCode.description: type=maps only (the richer Maps shape; type=places returns the lean serper-parity set).

countryCode.description: ISO country code. type=maps only (the richer Maps shape; type=places returns the lean serper-parity set).

location.description: {lat,lng}. type=maps only (the richer Maps shape; type=places returns the lean serper-parity set).

phone.description: Formatted phone number. Null when Google does not show one. type=maps only (the richer Maps shape; type=places returns the lean serper-parity set).

phoneUnformatted.description: E.164-style phone number. type=maps only (the richer Maps shape; type=places returns the lean serper-parity set).

categoryName.description: Primary Google category. type=maps only (the richer Maps shape; type=places returns the lean serper-parity set).

categories.description: All Google categories. type=maps only (the richer Maps shape; type=places returns the lean serper-parity set).

totalScore.description: Average star rating (same value as rating). type=maps only (the richer Maps shape; type=places returns the lean serper-parity set).

description.description: Google's editorial summary when present. type=maps only (the richer Maps shape; type=places returns the lean serper-parity set).

openingHours.description: Day name to hours string, e.g. {"Monday":"7:30 AM-2 PM"}. type=maps only (the richer Maps shape; type=places returns the lean serper-parity set).

permanentlyClosed.description: type=maps only (the richer Maps shape; type=places returns the lean serper-parity set).

mainImage.description: Primary place photo. type=maps only (the richer Maps shape; type=places returns the lean serper-parity set).

attributes.description: Google's attribute groups, e.g. {"Service options":["Takeout"]}. type=maps only (the richer Maps shape; type=places returns the lean serper-parity set).

scrapedAt.description: When this record was collected. type=maps only (the richer Maps shape; type=places returns the lean serper-parity set).

link.description: Google product page URL (always present since 2026-08).

imageUrl.description: Product thumbnail: a gstatic URL, or an inline data:image URI for some top-of-page rows.

source.description: The publisher's display name as Google shows it.

creator.description: Image creator from IPTC metadata (sparse — only when Google carries it).

likes.description: Total reactions on the review (sum across reaction types).

LinkedInResult.description: Polymorphic result. `type` echoes the request as linkedin-<type>; the populated data key depends on `type` (`people` for search).

type.description: linkedin-profile, linkedin-company, linkedin-posts, linkedin-jobs, or linkedin-search.

url.description: The requested LinkedIn URL (profile, company, posts, and url-based jobs calls).

query.description: The requested keywords (search and keyword-based jobs calls).

profile.description: type=profile: the person's public profile. Null with a `note` if the profile is private or empty (uncharged). Includes `photo` (the member's public profile photo URL, only ever present when the member's own settings make it visible to anyone without login) and `photoState` ('public' when a photo URL is returned; 'not_published' when LinkedIn serves no member photo publicly, in which case `photo` is null).

company.description: type=company: the public company page. Includes employees with employees=true.

posts.description: type=posts: public posts. Includes comments with comments=true.

people.description: type=search: matching people. With enrich=true each entry is the person's full profile.

note.description: Present when a profile is private or empty.
